Read a DICOM Structured Report (SR) or Advanced IOD

Source: R/sr.R
read_dicom_sr.Rd

Parses a DICOM Structured Report (dcmsr) or hierarchical DICOM dataset (including RT Plan/Dose/Structure Set, Segmentation, Parametric Map, and Tractography objects) into a tidy tibble::tibble preserving sequence hierarchy (depth and sequence_path).

Usage

read_dicom_sr(path)

Arguments

path

Path to a DICOM Structured Report (.dcm) file.

Value

A tibble::tibble with columns depth, sequence_path, tag, keyword, vr, and value.

Examples

sr_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".dcm")
create_dicom_sr(
  sr_file,
  title = "Chest CT Report",
  text = "No acute cardiopulmonary abnormality."
)
read_dicom_sr(sr_file)
